sources.legislators_json_status: 404 on 2026-10-04; YAML from the same repository was used

vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).

crosswalk.limitation: ZIP codes are looked up as 2020 Census ZCTAs, which are not the same as USPS ZIP codes. A ZCTA can overlap more than one congressional district and more than one state. Every overlap with land area greater than zero is kept. Water-only overlaps are counted and not assigned a representative. Rows with a blank ZCTA code in the Census file are skipped.

governors.as_of_rule: A governor is included only when an Open States executive role has type governor and start_date <= 2026-10-04 < end_date.
governors.excluded_note: The District of Columbia is not included. Open States labels the D.C. mayor with role type governor. That office is not a state governor and is not shown.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.

scope_text.house: House roll calls 1–323 of 2026 (323 votes, January 6, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the House Clerk.
scope_text.senate: Senate votes 1–262 of the 119th Congress, session 2 (262 votes, January 5, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the Senate LIS.

session_votes.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

x_posts.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

donor_industry_stats.note: members_with_data/no_itemized_data/errors describe the current cycle; shown_* says which single cycle each card displays. Retrieved totals add each card's shown cycle only.
